items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Asch told me that Norman brought in a tape for him to hear

ctx.x: No. That was on tape. I was trying to make a point... I made seven dates with him, and I never knew when he was (?), because he had those machines running back there, and you never knew what was going on. There wasn't no disks being made, though. That much I knew. Because I was checkin' that shit out. I said, "Well, I'll see what's happening so I can put my demands in front." But it must have been on tape, because there wasn't no disks being made.
Asch told me that Norman brought in a tape for him to hear, and that's why he was interested in putting it out --
